producer_report.summary:
I wrote docs/design/reviews/job-planning-review-1.md and added a CHANGELOG.md entry. The verdict is "build after the listed fixes": 0 High, 11 Medium and 10 Low findings. The review follows the format of parallel-jobs-review-1. It has a table of the design's (read) code claims, each marked confirmed, contradicted or unchecked with the line checked. Findings are grouped under sections 3 to 9, with the sizing and keep-rule tables inside the section 8 and 9 findings. `records/` is absent from the snapshot, so the design's record-derived figures are marked unchecked. Two claims are contradicted: `job_of` returns `None` for unknown record types (the panic is the `.expect` in `Records::load`, `store.rs` 273-276), and `FindingSource::Critic` does not exist (only `Verifier` and `Athena` do). The Medium findings concern these points:
- Planning invocations have no path into `produce_and_verify` or `close_dispatched`.
- The verifier would be given the plan, which is the producer model's reasoning.
- The prediction commit's `brief-producer.md` would not match the plan-augmented prompt.
- `FindingSource::Critic` is a new variant.
- Job 1 does not compile as listed, because `retry.rs` and `tests/common/mod.rs` match exhaustively on `Role`.
- A new `Config.job_plan` field could change every reading's `config_sha256`.
- Section 7 omits the "deterministic checks alone" alternative.
- The keep rule has three problems: its pass-rate denominator, its 30-job sample, and a cost condition that is nearly incompatible with the design's own cost estimate.
The review also recommends splitting jobs 3 and 5 as too large for one producer run. It finds section 8's ordering sound: the schema in job 1 comes before the only `athena.toml` edit in job 5. The design file and all code are unchanged.

open_issues: The review names the snapshot's base commit id (de62c08). If Athena rewrites the commit during landing, that id may not match history; the design's own 4adaf98 is cited as unverifiable.
Clippy was not run, since only Markdown changed; Athena will run it.
mistakes: The first draft's severity counts did not match the findings; I corrected them to 11 Medium and 10 Low before finishing.
My first CHANGELOG edit failed because the heading text was not unique; I retried with more context.
I did not read status.rs, display.rs, the rest of verify.rs, or the admission, checks and verifier part of produce_and_verify, and the review marks those as unchecked.
learnings: `Records::load` panics (`.expect`) on a record type `job_of` does not know; `job_of` itself returns None (store.rs 208-221, 273-276).
FindingSource has only Verifier and Athena (records.rs 215-218).

`reading_inputs` serializes the whole Config, and `config_sha256` is the digest of that text (capability.rs 45). A new Option field that serializes as null would change every existing reading's digest.
`crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs` `test_config()` is built from athena.toml via include_str, by splicing around the checks and [classes] regions.
The only job markdown files `check_record_file` accepts are brief-producer.md and brief-verifier.md (records.rs 1998).
Exhaustive matches on `Role` exist in athena-agent fake.rs 183, run_pin_tests.rs 153, tests/retry.rs 56 and tests/common/mod.rs 372, so adding a Role variant touches the CLI tests.
Policy tests do not require new prompt .md files to be listed in non-rust-files.md; markdown prompts count as data.
desires: records/ in the snapshot, so the design's baseline counts, introspection classes and job ids could be checked instead of left unchecked.
The commit the design says it read (4adaf98), to confirm its line references against the same tree.
